title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-21
lineage: Dat -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.1 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a classic ’82 NYC show with a smoking Playin' > Crazy Fingers opener, killer West LA Fadeaway and soaring High Time.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its clear, well‑balanced sound thanks to Charlie Miller’s engineering. Musically the concert delivers high energy – the explosive Playin' > Crazy Fingers opening, a funky West LA Fadeaway, and an uplifting High Time make it a standout example of late‑’80s Dead magic.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high ratings (mostly 4–5 stars) and enthusiastic comments about both performance and sound quality indicate a strong show with an excellent recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, well‑balanced mix; reviewers note "nice sound" and no dropouts or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Exciting opener with Playin' into Crazy Fingers sets a high‑energy tone, followed by a funky West LA Fadeaway and classic High Time, maintaining momentum throughout.
